# Abridged terminal manual sources

The Ava manual pages are original, truncated descriptions of the sealed adapters. They retain only behavior implemented by Delenda Quest and do not reproduce full upstream manuals.

Behavior and conventional syntax were checked against these open-source manuals:

- GNU Coreutils: https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/coreutils.html
- GNU Grep: https://www.gnu.org/software/grep/manual/grep.html
- GNU Findutils: https://www.gnu.org/software/findutils/manual/html_mono/find.html
- man-db: https://man-db.gitlab.io/man-db/
- procps-ng (`ps`): https://gitlab.com/procps-ng/procps
- systemd (`systemctl`): https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemctl.html
- cronie (`crontab`): https://github.com/cronie-crond/cronie
- Vim: https://vimhelp.org/
- GNU nano: https://www.nano-editor.org/dist/latest/nano.html
- Git: https://git-scm.com/docs
- SQLite: https://www.sqlite.org/cli.html
- jq: https://jqlang.org/manual/
- Homebrew: https://docs.brew.sh/Manpage
- util-linux (`column`): https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/column.1.html
- bc: https://www.gnu.org/software/bc/manual/html_mono/bc.html
- GNU Units: https://www.gnu.org/software/units/manual/units.html

`open`, `download`, `archive`, `ava doctor`, and the campaign metaphors are Delenda-specific adapters. Their man pages identify the sealed behavior directly and do not imply host access.
